description: This file defines the SaveQualificationLicenseController class, which manages the license editing and saving interface in the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract Vue controller and prepares a Vue component based on the presence of an 'id' attribute in the request.

classes.name: SaveQualificationLicenseController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing the Vue component for license data entry or editing, based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets the appropriate Vue component ('license-edit' or 'license-save') depending on whether an 'id' attribute exists in the request.
